messages:
Elena: FYI — ACME (org_9b2) opened a ticket: their console shows a 90-day default retention but contract signed for 30 days. They need a deletion timeline and audit proof for an upcoming compliance review. ticket#24581 
Ashwin: Can you paste the org id + which dataset(s) they mean? UI screenshot helps. Also: do they have a custom retention policy or using account default?
Elena: Org id is org_9b2. Customer flagged logs and embeddings under project `acme-prod`. Screenshot attached in ticket. They say they never set 90d explicitly.
Ashwin: Ok. First repro step: check the retention via API: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_9b2/retention"
```
That returns the configured TTL and source (policy/default). Share output if possible.
Elena: Ran that, response shows `{ "retention_days": 90, "source": "legacy-default" }`. Pasting snippets to ticket.
Tim (Infra): That "legacy-default" token sounds like the migration that bumped some old orgs to 90d in 2024. We need to verify DB row and the migration run id. Elena — can you collect `retention_policy` row for org_9b2 and the `migration_applied` tag?
Elena: Grabbed from prod-read replica: `retention_policy { org_id: org_9b2, retention_days: 90, created_at: 2024-11-08, source: legacy-migration-202411 }`. Adding to ticket.
Samir: LegalOps here — put a legal hold on org_9b2 immediately. We cannot allow automatic deletion while compliance reviews. Please disable scheduled deletions and mark the org as "hold:legal_pending". Also we need an audit log snapshot (export) and KMS key usage history for the affected buckets.
Tim (Infra): Acknowledged. Creating hold flag now and pausing the deletion job for org_9b2. I'll also trigger an audit log export to secure storage (S3 encrypted, retention 365 days).
SupportBot: Created incident INC-2026-67 and linked ticket#24581 -> incident. Assigned to eng-runtime-sre.
Elena: Customer is asking for expected deletion timeline if hold is not applied — with 90d the earliest scheduled purge is 2025-02-06. With contract 30d they expected 2024-11-07. We need to propose next steps to customer: 1) confirm hold in place, 2) offer KMS audit export + audit snapshot, 3) schedule correction to 30d or offer expedited purge.
Ashwin: I'll own the rollback to contractual default if Legal OKs. Plan: revert retention_days to 30 in a transactional update and attach audit trail. Need Legal sign-off before changing data-affecting policy.
Samir: Confirmed — LegalOps authorizes policy update after we capture the export and the hold is documented. Do NOT perform delete operations until sign-off.
Tim (Infra): Added runbook steps to INC-2026-67 and created a KB draft for how migration accidentally set legacy-default -> 90d. Linking CL-4521 to schedule a permanent fix.
Elena: Notifying customer now: will confirm legal hold, share audit export ETA (~2 hours), and propose next call. Adding customer contact to ticket. :thumbsup:
Ashwin: Thanks — tagging eng-runtime-sre for implementation once Legal gives final approval.
Samir: Thanks team, keeping this high priority.
SupportBot: Note: escalation level set to P1. Reminders scheduled every hour until resolution.
